entities.name: food_I
entities.attrs: Food type I, 10 kg/h per skilled/fully-trained worker

entities.name: food_II
entities.attrs: Food type II, 6 kg/h per skilled/fully-trained worker

entities.name: train_slot
entities.attrs: Training capacity: 1 skilled worker can train up to 3 trainees in 2 weeks

decisions.name: x_s_w
decisions.attrs: Number of skilled workers working in week w (40h, wage 360/y)

decisions.name: x_o_w
decisions.attrs: Number of skilled workers working overtime in week w (60h, wage 540/y)

decisions.name: x_t_w
decisions.attrs: Number of trainees in training during week w (wage 120/y, no production)

decisions.name: x_f_w
decisions.attrs: Number of fully trained workers working in week w (40h, wage 240/y)

decisions.name: d_I_w
decisions.attrs: Shortfall (kg) of food I in week w (penalty 0.5 yuan/kg per week late)

decisions.name: d_II_w
decisions.attrs: Shortfall (kg) of food II in week w (penalty 0.6 yuan/kg per week late)

constraints.attrs: At most 50 skilled workers total; some may be training
Must train 50 new workers by end of week 8

constraints.expr: x_t_w[w] <= 3 * x_s_train[w] for each training period of 2 weeks
constraints.attrs: 1 skilled can train up to 3 trainees over 2 weeks
Food I output: 10 kg/h per worker, 40h or 60h week
Food II output: 6 kg/h per worker, 40h or 60h week
Food I demand must be met (with possible shortfall d_I_w)
Food II demand must be met (with possible shortfall d_II_w)
Fully trained workers available = cumulative trainees finished training

relations.detail: Production decisions use skilled/fully-trained worker resources
A skilled worker cannot both train and produce simultaneously
Trainees become fully trained workers after 2 weeks of training

coupling_groups.implication: Aggregate capacity constraint needed across all worker allocation decisions
